subject: SIG questionnaire & artifacts for MedSys Health — follow-up
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsys.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG & artifacts request — MedSys procurement

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the demo last week — our security team wants to complete vendor intake for Redwood before we can move to a procurement SOW. Attached is our SIG template (we'll import later), and the team asked if you can provide the following artifacts:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) — a redacted copy is fine under NDA
- Penetration test summary / executive findings
- ISO statements or certification evidence (ISO 27001 if available)
- High-level security deck for application architecture and data flows

Can you send the completed SIG (we only need answers in the spreadsheet) and the artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-17)? If you need an NDA, tell me and I'll arrange one from procurement.

Also: one specific ask from our security analyst — can you confirm whether customer data is stored encrypted at rest with customer-controlled keys (KMS/HSM)? If so, which KMS providers do you integrate with?

Appreciate it — Liam
Procurement Lead, MedSys Health
liam.oconnor@medsys.co
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsys.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG & artifacts request — MedSys procurement

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list and the deadline. We'll get this over to you. Quick plan:

1) We'll return the completed SIG spreadsheet (answers + evidence pointers) by end of day 6/16.
2) We'll share redacted SOC 2 and pen-test summary via a secured Drive link once an NDA is in place; if MedSys prefers we can also upload to the link you provide.
3) Security deck and ISO statement we can attach directly to the SIG reply.

To confirm KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault for Private deployments; for Hosted we use envelope encryption with customer options on Dedicated/Private (we'll include precise wording in the SIG).

Marissa — taking point on assembling the artifacts listed below. Karthik — can you confirm the pen test redaction policy (what we can share) and the date of the last test so I can call it out in the spreadsheet?

Liam — if you can send a simple NDA link (or confirm you need ours) we'll push SOC2 and the full pen-test summary after it's signed. Otherwise, we'll include the redacted pen-test executive summary attached.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG & artifacts request — MedSys procurement

Monica / Karthik — FYI, I pulled the latest artifacts from secure storage this morning. Attached to this email I'm dropping: Redwood_Security_Deck_v3.pdf (internal redactions reviewed), ISO27001_Statement_2024.pdf, and a redacted SOC 2 file (Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2025_REDACTED.pdf).

Pen test: our vendor completed an external pentest in Nov 2025. We can share the executive summary (two pages) without an NDA; the full report requires an NDA and a secure link. Karthik, can you confirm the two-page executive summary filename so Monica can attach it to SIG?

Also adding a quick note for the SIG answers: for the KMS question use this wording — "Customer-managed keys are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments via AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault. Hosted API uses envelope encryption; contact your account team for key management options." We'll paste that directly into the SIG cells.

Marissa
Director, Solutions
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Dana Schultz <dana.schultz@acme-medical.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsys.co>
Date: 2026-06-16T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG & artifacts request — MedSys procurement

Hi Monica / Liam,

Thanks — this is helpful. Two quick clarifications from our security team:

- We will require the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA (standard) — please send DocuSign NDA link and we'll route to legal.
- Pen test executive summary is fine to share now. If you can provide the filenames and a short digest (scope, high-level findings, remediation status), that will speed our review.

If you can meet the 6/17 EOD target for the SIG+attachments, procurement will schedule the SOW review for next week.

Best,
Dana Schultz
Security Program Manager (on behalf of MedSys security)
dana.schultz@acme-medical.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Schultz <dana.schultz@acme-medical.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsys.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG & artifacts request — MedSys procurement

Hi Dana / Liam —

Great, thanks for confirming. Quick status update and links:

- SIG spreadsheet: attached (SIG-completed-answers-20260616.xlsx) — answers filled and we've added evidence pointers in the "notes" column for each control.
- SOC 2: redacted copy attached (Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2025_REDACTED.pdf). For the full SOC 2 report we'll provide access after NDA.
- Pen test: attached is PenTest_Summary_2025_redacted.pdf — scope covered external network and public-facing inference endpoints; executive findings show two medium issues remediated (CVE-2025-XXXXX patch applied) and no critical findings. Remediation dates included in the summary. Full report available under NDA.
- ISO: ISO27001_Statement_2024.pdf attached.
- Security deck: Redwood_Security_Deck_v3.pdf attached — includes architecture diagram and data flow (sensitive items redacted for public distribution).

NDA: If you'd like to use your NDA, please send the DocuSign link and we'll have legal sign. If you prefer ours, here's the DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/ndasign/medsys-nda-2026 — once signed I'll send the secure SOC 2 access link.

If anything in the SIG needs further detail (e.g., sample logs, retention windows, or key rotation policy excerpts) call that out in your review and we can provide the text or additional artifacts.

Thanks — aiming to make procurement painless.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: SIG-completed-answers-20260616.xlsx; Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_2025_REDACTED.pdf; PenTest_Summary_2025_redacted.pdf; ISO27001_Statement_2024.pdf; Redwood_Security_Deck_v3.pdf
